description: Create or change one of the user's team skills: instructions an agent follows, naming capabilities as @provider/capability. Without id, creates one: write name, description and body, or copy a skill under /library/skills with from (its id: <id> for /library/skills/firecrawl/<id>, team:<slug> for /library/skills/team/<slug>); fields you also give override the copy, and a library skill copies its SKILL.md only. The new skill is enabled and listed in /library/skills/INDEX as /library/skills/team/<slug>; a taken slug is a conflict. With id (team:<slug>) and baseVersion, the version: in its SKILL.md, changes its name, description or body (a new version), or whether it is enabled or listed; a skill changed since is refused with conflict, so read it again and reapply. A body edited from the text you read must write each capability as @provider/capability again: the plain code it shows saves no reference. Library skills cannot be changed; copy one. Skills cannot be deleted here. Returns the saved skill's path and the command that reads it. Save only what the user asked for. Free.

baseVersion.description: Update, required: the version: in the skill's SKILL.md. A skill changed since is refused with conflict: read it again and reapply.

body.description: The instructions in full, in Markdown; required to create without from. Reference capabilities as @provider/capability.

description.description: When to use the skill; required to create without from.

enabled.description: Update: turn the skill on or off.

from.description: Create: the skill to copy, by id: <id> for /library/skills/firecrawl/<id>, team:<slug> for /library/skills/team/<slug>. Fields you also give override the copy.

id.description: Update: the team:<slug> skill to change. Omit to create a skill.

name.description: Skill name; required to create without from.

objective.description: The user's underlying goal in one sentence, not a restatement of this call's arguments. Reuse it across related calls. Firecrawl uses it to learn what agents need and improve its results. No personal data, secrets or the user's exact words.

slug.description: Create: lowercase words joined by hyphens; defaults to one made from the name.

name: firecrawl_save_skill
